headline: Six live unbooked replies is the whole game today. One more reply trips the 10-reply gate and books the booking verdict red at 1 of 10; working the six before that happens is free cash and a saved scorecard.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Work the 6 unbooked replies in tier order: Ryan, rahul and Caleb replied inside 24 hours and are live right now, Adam and Matt are at 3 days, Owen, mrplusmoney and cblez are past a week. Evening window, 5 to 10pm Irish, is when they answer.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Reply rate sits at 1.3% on 713 sends against the 3% floor. Account health is still the prime suspect ahead of copy, per the message-dead rules. Chase the warm-up vendor for a delivery date on accounts 2 and 3.
